controlledChrome.scope: real Chrome primitives; controlled local application; NOT live ChatGPT
controlledChrome.baseline: FAIL at original positive evidence survives a lost reply

controlledCases: A positive original member appeared and then failed in separate renderer turns while no native read was made.
